scanner_c.notes: Model-curated financial news for roughly the prior 24 hours ending 2026-09-03 11:35 UTC. items.event_title: Broadcom raises long-term AI chip sales forecast as hyperscaler spending stays strong
items.news_summary: Broadcom raised its AI-chip revenue outlook to about $115B for FY2027 and roughly $230B for FY2028 while reporting Q3 AI-chip sales of $16.7B; Q4 total-revenue guidance was slightly below consensus.
items.investor_materiality: Very high: directly affects AVGO valuation, custom accelerator competition with Nvidia, networking demand and the durability of hyperscaler AI capex.
items.selection_reason: One of the clearest fresh mega-cap semiconductor catalysts in the window, with both upside AI guidance and a near-term revenue-guidance wrinkle.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters company-results reporting; high-quality primary financial-news source.
items.youtube_query: Broadcom AVGO AI chip forecast earnings

items.event_title: Snowflake lifts annual product-revenue forecast as AI demand accelerates
items.news_summary: Snowflake beat quarterly expectations and raised FY2027 product-revenue guidance to $6.07B from $5.84B; management said AI products contributed roughly half of the recent growth acceleration, and shares jumped more than 20% after hours/premarket.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for cloud/software valuation and AI monetization; it is a clean read-through on enterprise AI demand beyond infrastructure hardware.
items.selection_reason: Large-cap-ish U.S. software name with a major post-earnings move and explicit AI-driven acceleration.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters earnings and market-move reporting with company guidance figures.

items.event_title: Dell raises annual forecast on record AI-server demand
items.news_summary: Dell raised annual revenue guidance to about $192B from $167B and EPS guidance to $25.50 from $17.90, citing a roughly $95B AI-server backlog and $60B of orders; shares rose around 11%.
items.investor_materiality: Very high for Dell, Nvidia-powered AI servers, storage demand and the wider AI-infrastructure supply chain.
items.selection_reason: A major news-driven move in a large U.S. hardware company with unusually large guidance revisions and direct AI-capex exposure.
items.youtube_query: Dell DELL AI server forecast earnings
items.video_angle: Dell把全年营收预期一次抬高250亿美元：AI服务器需求到底有多夸张？

items.event_title: HPE raises annual forecasts and expands Oracle AI-data-center networking deal
items.news_summary: HPE beat quarterly estimates, raised FY2026 and FY2027 forecasts, and expanded its Oracle collaboration to deploy HPE Juniper networking across Oracle AI data centers; management also flagged memory, NAND, CPU and drive supply constraints.
items.investor_materiality: High: read-through for enterprise AI infrastructure, networking, memory supply and Oracle data-center buildouts.
items.selection_reason: Combines earnings, higher guidance and a concrete hyperscale/AI networking agreement in one fresh catalyst.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters-syndicated report plus WSJ earnings coverage; both cite company figures.
items.youtube_query: HPE Oracle AI data center earnings
items.video_angle: HPE财报爆表但盘后反跌：AI订单太多，反而被内存和供应链卡住了？

items.event_title: China's Moonshot confidentially files for Hong Kong IPO aiming to raise about $3B
items.news_summary: Reuters reported that Moonshot, developer of Kimi, confidentially filed for a Hong Kong IPO targeting about $3B. The company is also reportedly in talks with Microsoft, Amazon and Google on hosting/revenue-sharing arrangements.
items.investor_materiality: High thematic relevance to Chinese AI valuations, Hong Kong tech IPOs, U.S. cloud distribution and Nvidia export-control scrutiny.
items.selection_reason: A large potential AI IPO with direct links to U.S. hyperscalers and China/U.S. AI competition.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters exclusive/sourced reporting; IPO details are source-based rather than company-confirmed.
items.youtube_query: Moonshot Kimi Hong Kong IPO Microsoft Amazon Google

items.event_title: Vertiv agrees to buy Utility Innovation Group for up to $2.6B
items.news_summary: Vertiv agreed to acquire microgrid and advanced-power-controls company Utility Innovation Group for $1.45B cash plus up to $1.15B contingent consideration, expanding its ability to solve power bottlenecks for data centers.
items.investor_materiality: High for VRT and the AI data-center power/cooling ecosystem; microgrids are becoming a key constraint-solving technology for new AI campuses.
items.selection_reason: A material M&A deal in one of the market's most important AI-infrastructure bottlenecks: power availability.

items.event_title: Taiwan says companies plan another $20B of U.S. investment driven by AI demand
items.news_summary: Taiwan's economy minister said Taiwanese companies plan an additional $20B of investment in the United States, driven by AI demand, on top of large previously announced semiconductor investments.
items.investor_materiality: High read-through for U.S. semiconductor reshoring, equipment suppliers, construction, TSMC ecosystem capex and U.S.-Taiwan supply-chain policy.
items.selection_reason: Fresh cross-border capex commitment tied directly to AI and U.S. semiconductor capacity.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting based on Taiwan economy-ministry comments.
items.youtube_query: Taiwan $20B US AI semiconductor investment TSMC

items.event_title: Solvay to more than double Taiwan semiconductor-grade peroxide capacity
items.news_summary: Solvay plans to increase ultra-pure hydrogen peroxide capacity in Taiwan from about 35,000 tonnes to more than 70,000 tonnes annually by end-2026 and aims to triple its electronic-grade peroxide business over five to seven years.
items.investor_materiality: Medium-high: a less crowded upstream signal of sub-5nm fab expansion and AI-driven semiconductor materials demand, especially around TSMC's Taiwan capacity.
items.selection_reason: Concrete capacity expansion in a critical but underfollowed semiconductor consumables niche.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting with company capacity targets.
items.youtube_query: Solvay Taiwan semiconductor peroxide TSMC capacity

items.entity: Samsung Electronics / SK hynix power infrastructure
items.event_title: KEPCO proposes large advance power payments from Samsung and SK hynix
items.news_summary: Reuters cited a Korean newspaper report that KEPCO proposed Samsung Electronics prepay about 20 trillion won (~$15B) for electricity through 2031 and suggested a similar 5 trillion won payment from SK hynix to fund grid expansion.
items.investor_materiality: High thematic relevance to the electricity intensity of Korean semiconductor expansion and the capital burden behind memory/HBM capacity growth.
items.selection_reason: An unusually large proposed power-funding structure shows electricity infrastructure becoming a semiconductor-capacity constraint.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting based on Chosun Ilbo/internal-document reporting; proposal status should be emphasized.
items.youtube_query: Samsung SK hynix KEPCO power $15B semiconductor

items.event_title: Japan's FX chief remains on alert as yen moves fuel intervention and BOJ speculation
items.news_summary: Japan's top currency diplomat Atsushi Mimura said authorities remain vigilant over yen moves; traders have increasingly linked the yen's strength to expectations for further Bank of Japan rate hikes rather than confirmed intervention.
items.investor_materiality: High macro read-through for global yields, Japanese carry trades, exporters and U.S. risk assets if BOJ tightening expectations strengthen.
items.selection_reason: Fresh official comments arrive while global bond yields are elevated and the yen/BOJ path can transmit quickly into global equity positioning.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters reporting of official Japanese comments; intervention is not confirmed.
items.youtube_query: Japan yen BOJ rate hike intervention Mimura
